Capture view-once Instants as you view them, so you can re-view and download them later from “View saved Instants”.
No saved Instants yet. Open some Instants with capture enabled and they\'ll appear here.
Captures incoming DMs locally as they arrive from the server. Marks messages as deleted when unsent, so you can view them even after the sender deletes them.
No deleted messages captured yet.\nEnable the feature and messages will be saved as they arrive.
Notifies when a received message is unsent

Downloads every received DM photo, video and voice message as it arrives, on any network, so it uses mobile data and up to 8 GB of storage. Media of messages that are not unsent is removed after 30 days, except view-once media, which stays until you delete it. After you turn this setting off, nothing new is saved, and once Instagram restarts the cleanup stops too. Saved media opens from View deleted messages after you confirm your screen lock, on Android 11 or newer.

Saves view-once and view-twice photos, videos and voice messages as they arrive, without opening them, so the sender is not told. They stay until you delete them and count toward the 8 GB; when they fill it, nothing new is saved. When off, view-once media is not saved, and camera photos and videos may be skipped while Make ephemeral media permanent is on.
This saved media can\'t be read
